title: Marae Lassel - Quick Start
intro: DreamWeave tasks and treasure maps for the 180 Lowlands, 225 High Country and 275 Plateau.
before: Have an updated RynthCore and RynthAi, with a working combat and loot profile. Enable RynthNav only if you want mesh map travel.
Your /ls command must return you to the 275 Plateau camp. Test that before starting.
steps: Close the game. Right-click the downloaded ZIP, choose Extract All, then open the extracted folder.

Double-click INSTALL-MARAE.cmd. It finds RynthAi automatically. If a folder picker opens, choose your RynthAi folder containing MetaFiles or NavProfiles. Your RynthSuite folder also works; any drive is fine.
Open RynthCore > Plugins > Add Plugin. Paste with Ctrl+V in the file-name box: the installer copied the full DLL path. Select it and enable ACAI2.Marae. Keep RynthAi enabled.

Log into DreamWeave and click the ACAI2 Marae map icon in Rynth’s bar, or type /acai2marae. Choose your areas and options below, then click Start / Resume. The app loads its mission and routes for you.
options: Tick the areas you want to visit.
Also work treasure maps while hunting. Keep Treasure Map and wanted corpse loot enabled in your loot profile.
ON: skip NPC tasks and repeat the hunting route. OFF: talk to hunters, do tasks and turn them in.
A maximum per camp. Finish early and move on, or turn in completed work when the limit is reached. After all camps, hunt in 180.
Optional; needs RynthNav. Default close/far steps are 30/130 yards. The sliders tune the next mesh step.
ON by default. Checks nearby caches after fights, even with maps off. Inaccessible caches get bounded attempts; hunting resumes.
tips: Suggested tasks + maps: tick your areas and Use maps; leave Hunt only OFF. Enable the 2-hour limit if you want a bounded daily circuit.
Start / Resume keeps progress. New run starts the area's task checks over. Stop saves progress and stops automatic login resume.
Map icon or /acai2marae opens the panel. Closing it does not stop hunting. PLUGIN-PATH.txt is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ACAI2\Marae.
Wrong data location? In the app, open Advanced and set the folder containing MetaFiles / NavProfiles. You can also rerun the installer.
Watch the first NPC and map/cache before leaving it unattended. If a pickup needs review, check your pack/cache before clicking the review button.
credit: Soot (xSoot / SootAC): nav paths and the hard work on the original mission logic, including his custom RynthAi DLL implementation. ACAI2 adaptation: standalone app, stock-RynthAi compatibility and packaging.
